{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Performs given [[Eden Editor: Actions|Eden Editor action]].
{{Feature|warning|
Prior to {{GVI|arma3|2.12|size= 0.75}} it was possible to use this command outside of [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]].<br>
For example <sqf inline>do3DENAction "MissionSave";</sqf> would wipe the [[mission.sqm]] without a way to restore it when executed accidentally during preview.
}}

|s1= [[do3DENAction]] action

|p1= action: [[String]] - see [[Eden Editor: Actions]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2since= arma3 2.22

|s2= [[do3DENAction]] [action, argument]

|p21= action: [[String]] - see [[Eden Editor: Actions]]

|p22= argument: [[Anything]] - depends on the used [[Eden Editor: Actions|action]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>do3DENAction "MissionSave";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
// Since 2.22
private _par = createHashMap;
_par set ["name", "testfile"];
_par set ["folder", "subfolder"];
_par set ["content", "R3voing"];

do3DENAction ["CreateTextFile", _par];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[get3DENActionState]]
}}
